scope: Independent black-box GET /sources acceptance; frozen before test implementation

Only persisted authorized sources appear; absent IDs and empty grants produce []

Global ambiguity includes unauthorized sources; duplicates within one source remain unique
All ambiguous or absent entry lists omit source; mixed unique entries retain requestable entries
Discovery works with no successful content; selected populated/empty entries work through /results
Source entry changes reflected immediately; old entry absent, changed entry remains requestable
Read-only DB credentials, unchanged DB/S3 snapshots and no origin requests
Stopped MinIO does not prevent discovery; stopped DB yields bounded database_unavailable503
Complete catalog exceeding page_max_bytes fails archive_too_large500 without truncation
Real DB lock exercises timeout and configured worker busy limits; recovery releases slots
